story_text: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Booking fails when name is missing
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the name field
3. Click submit
positive.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the name field is required

positive.title: Booking fails when room type is missing
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the room type field
3. Click submit
positive.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the room type field is required

positive.title: Booking fails when check-in date is missing
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the check-in date field
3. Click submit
positive.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the check-in field is required

positive.title: Booking fails when check-out date is missing
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the check-out date field
3. Click submit
positive.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the check-out field is required

positive.title: Each missing field returns a descriptive error message
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Each time before submission keep a different field empty
3. Click submit
positive.expected_result: All message to return descriptive error messages

negative.title: Booking fails when all required fields are missing simultaneously
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Keep all fields empty
3. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error message prompting the user that required fields are missing

edge.title: Booking fails when a required field is present but empty string
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the name field keep as empty string
3. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the name field is required

edge.title: Booking fails when a required field contains only whitespace
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields except the name field add spaces only
3. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error prompt stating that the name field is required
